targets.rawSql: SELECT total FROM v_active_repositories_total;
SELECT contributors FROM v_active_contributors_30d_total;
SELECT commits FROM v_commits_30d_total;
SELECT prs FROM v_prs_created_30d_total;
SELECT merged_prs as merged FROM v_merged_prs_30d_total;
SELECT open_prs FROM v_open_prs_total;

SELECT time, team, commits
FROM v_team_commits_daily_trend_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT time, team, created
FROM v_team_pr_creation_daily_trend_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT time, team, merged
FROM v_team_pr_merge_daily_trend_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT time, team, contributors
FROM v_team_active_contributors_daily_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT time, team, added, removed
FROM v_team_lines_changed_daily_trend_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT repo_id, repository, team, commits_30d, contributors_30d, open_prs, merged_prs_30d, vulnerabilities, stale_branches, last_analyzed_at
FROM v_team_repository_health_matrix
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY commits_30d DESC;

SELECT size, SUM(count) as count
FROM v_team_pr_size_distribution_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY size;

SELECT severity, SUM(count) as count
FROM v_team_vulnerabilities_by_severity_latest
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 
  END;

SELECT language, SUM(lines) as lines
FROM v_team_language_distribution_latest
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY lines DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT contributor, SUM(commits) as commits
FROM v_team_top_contributors_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY contributor
ORDER BY commits DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT reviewer, SUM(reviews) as reviews
FROM v_team_top_reviewers_30d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY reviewer
ORDER BY reviews DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT team, repositories, contributors, commits_30d, open_prs, merged_prs_30d, avg_merge_time_days
FROM v_team_performance_summary
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY commits_30d DESC;

SELECT repo_id, repository, team, pr_number as "PR #", title, author, status, size, files, approvals, created_at
FROM v_team_recent_prs_7d
WHERE team IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 25;
